description: Find iOS apps by name or keyword, using Apple's iTunes Search API at call time (a text search over Apple's catalogue, not our own data). Returns app_store_id, name, developer, category id, rating, rating count and price for each match. Call this first to turn an app name into the app_store_id (the 'app_id' argument) that every per-app tool needs.
name: search_apps
title: Search apps
